title: Pals Rewards Points Earned and Reversed on Tailwise Autoship
content:
**Rewards team bulletin — earning on Tailwise Autoship**

Each charged Tailwise Autoship shipment earns Pals Rewards points on its merchandise subtotal after the Autoship discount, at the member's base earn rate multiplied by the program's points multiplier. Shipping, surcharges and packaging fees never earn. A refunded claim reverses the points the claimed units earned. A customer without a Pals Rewards membership in status active earns nothing, and points are not earned retroactively after enrollment.

## Earning, condition by condition

| Pals Rewards membership in status active | Shipment charged | Points |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Earned on the merchandise subtotal after the Autoship discount, at the base rate multiplied by the program multiplier |
| No | Yes | None, and none later for this shipment |

## Worked example (hypothetical base rate of 1 point per dollar)

Autoship Everyday shipment (multiplier 2): merchandise subtotal 60.00 USD, Autoship discount 3.00 USD, shipping fee 4.95 USD, heavy surcharge 6.99 USD. Qualifying amount: 57.00 USD. Points: 57.00 at 1 point per dollar, multiplied by 2, that is 114 points. The shipping fee and the surcharge earn nothing.

A later refunded claim on that shipment reverses the points earned by the claimed units.
